name: Cox School of Business
analysis: Edwin L. Cox School of Business, SMU, after the David B. Miller Business Quadrangle expansion. Layout from SMU's first-floor map fitted to the 2018 lidar; heights from the lidar (Fincher roof 18-22 m, cupola 32 m; wings 12-20 m); details from Commons and contractor photos: Fincher's slate roof, seven dormers a side, brick tower and white belvedere with gold dome; limestone glass commons; Maguire and Crow rotundas; pedimented Bolin-Bridwell and Sheffield halls with arcades.
